lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.bar: Company 会社予想 for FY2027/2 (ending 2027-02-20): 売上高 862.78億円 (+6.0%), 営業利益 43.0億円 (+9.2%), 経常利益 44.4億円 (+6.5%), 純利益 27.3億円 (+20.3%), set 2026-04-03 and reaffirmed at Q1 on 2026-06-22. IFIS consensus 経常 is 4,440百万 -- the same number. https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=consNewsDetail&nid=3333_20260403_act_20260403_130015_1 and https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZRST0575617S6A620C2000000/ . Sized against the H1 OP the guide implies at this name's historical H1 share of full-year OP (~88% of 43.0億 = ~37.8億); I expect roughly 33-35億.
hunter_view.positioning_check: JPX 空売り残高報告 register carries no disclosed short position at or above the 0.5% threshold for 3333 as of 2026-09-18 (sealed baseline, source https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html) -- a real zero, truncated at 0.5%, so there is no squeeze fuel behind a negative call and no crowded short to fade. 信用倍率 3.16 (margin longs 3.16x margin shorts, baseline, broker-portal scrape) is a mild retail long overhang rather than a short. There is no single-stock option market in Japan for this name, so there is no skew and no event-implied move; the only directional content in the baseline is run_up_20d_pct of -2.79%, which leans very slightly positive (priced_lean -0.11%).
hunter_view.baseline_tension: It cuts mildly against the baseline: run_up_20d of -2.79% gives a slightly POSITIVE priced lean (-0.11% net) on the view that a name drifting down into a print has already discounted something, whereas what I found says the discount is not yet in the sell-side number at all -- but the stock's PBR of 0.81 and 3.84% DOE-floored yield say the equity market has already stopped believing the plan even while IFIS has not, which is the main reason my number is small.

flags: 1 finding(s) worth -6.00 dated after the exit window, kept out of the key

findings.finding: The FY2027/2 company plan the whole market is anchored on (revenue 862.78億 +6.0%, OP 43.0億 +9.2%) requires roughly +7.5% revenue growth across the remaining nine months after a Q1 that grew 3%, at a time when the company has explicitly told investors it is suppressing new store openings under VISION2028 and its own published monthly existing-store series is running around flat -- and IFIS consensus 経常 for the year is 4,440百万, exactly the company number, so no analyst has marked the plan down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance is the line that moves this stock, and it moves it hard when it is cut: the 2025-12-22 業績予想の修正 (revenue 858億 to 810億, OP 56.2億 to 42.3億) drove the shares down in the afternoon session and again the following day ('後場下げ幅を拡大', then '続落'), and the baseline's estimated December-2024 reaction is -6.42%. Reported-quarter surprises by contrast have been looked through: the FY2026/2 result on 2026-04-03 missed IFIS 経常 consensus by 5.3% and the stock set its 2026 high of 1,457 that day because the new mid-term plan landed with it. The estimated September reactions are small and mixed (-3.36, +1.87, +1.67).

findings.finding: H1 operating profit is set to fall high-single to low-double digits year on year, because Q2 (May 21-Aug 20) is this company's thinnest-margin quarter -- prior-year Q2 standalone OP was only about 5.4億 on about 190億 of revenue, a ~2.8% margin, derived from H1 OP 37億 less Q1 OP ~31.6億 -- and Q1 already carried +8% personnel cost growth from wage rises and hiring plus new-store depreciation against revenue growth of just 3%, so a near-flat Q2 revenue line converts into a Q2 OP roughly half of last year's.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This stock has repeatedly not punished a weak reported half. The 2025-09 H1 print (revenue 459億 -1%, OP 37億 -21%, net 26億 -19%) sits on the estimated cadence as a +1.67% reaction, and the 2026-04-03 full-year print missed consensus 経常 by 5.3% and closed at the year's high. The reported quarter is not where this name's risk premium sits.

outside_window.finding: The pattern that actually resizes this stock is a 業績予想の修正 filed in December, not at H1 -- the 2025-12-22 cut took revenue from 858億 to 810億 and OP from 56.2億 to 42.3億 and was sold hard. If the FY2027/2 plan is unreachable on the arithmetic above, the most likely date the market sees it confirmed is the Q3 print or a separate revision around late December 2026, months after this exit.

lessons_applied: researcher_japan/LESSONS.md holds no rules yet -- it is deliberately empty pending a resolved Japanese run -- so nothing in it forced a change; what it does hold are three open questions, and question 2 ('Do monthly disclosures pre-empt the print? ... the honest size is smaller than it looks') applies literally here because all six months of H1 were published as 月次 by 2026-09-03.

On that basis I cut finding 2, the reported-quarter H1 operating-profit finding, from -1.0 to -0.5, because it rests almost entirely on data already in the public record (the 2026-06-22 Q1 release and the monthly series); impact_sum moved from -3.0 to -2.5.
Left finding 1 at -2.0: its unpriced component is that IFIS consensus 経常 equals the company guide exactly, which is not visible in any monthly and is not pre-empted by them.

Question 1 (進捗率 is the bar) confirmed the bar I had already chosen -- the company's own FY plan, not sell-side EPS -- so no change there. Question 3 (a prior 業績予想の修正 kills the event) does not bite: no revision has been filed for this fiscal year.
expected_move_pct revised from -2.0 to -1.6 so that it stays visibly smaller than the (now -2.5) sum of findings, as my own conviction note's four caveats require.

hunter_view.bar: The company's own FY2027/2 会社予想 — 営業収益 ¥245,622m (+8.8%), 営業利益 ¥12,590m (+0.9%), 経常利益 ¥12,580m (+0.1%), 純利益 ¥8,660m (-3.6%), announced 2026-04-10 (https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZRST0501415Q6A410C2000000/) and reaffirmed at Q1 on 2026-06-24. There is NO published sell-side consensus — IFIS 株予報 shows a dash for analyst forecasts (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&bcode=2742&sa=report) — so the only bar is the company guide and the 進捗率 against it. Plan-implied H1 営業利益 = 47.7% of ¥12,590m = ~¥6,005m (47.7% is last year's H1 経常 progress against the then-current FY guide). My estimate is ~¥5,250m, hence -12%.
hunter_view.positioning_check: JPX 空売り残高報告: ZERO disclosed short positions at or above the 0.5% threshold as of 2026-09-18 (sealed baseline, source https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html) — a real zero, so there is no squeeze fuel behind a negative and equally no crowded short already positioned for it. 信用倍率 6.21 (margin long balance 6.2x margin short balance, baseline as of 2026-09-18): a retail long overhang, which is the supply that shows up on a disappointing print and is the reason the baseline's own lean is -0.46. Days-to-cover is not computable — no aggregate short balance is published for a name with no disclosed reporters. There is no skew: Japan has no liquid single-stock option market, so `options` is all-null and nothing in the price states a direction out loud.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: It agrees with the baseline rather than cutting against it — the run-up is only +1.26% so there is almost nothing directional built in, and the baseline's own -0.46 lean is driven by the same 信用倍率 6.21 retail long overhang that would supply the selling on a weak H1, so my negative is additive to the free control rather than fighting it; the honest discomfort is that the free control already points the same way and the incremental information I am adding is one quarter of unobservable margin.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit should land near ¥5.2bn, about -10% YoY, for a 進捗率 of ~42% against the ¥12,590m full-year guide versus a ~48% norm — because the Q1 margin collapse (OP margin 5.65% -> 4.71%, -94bp, on 人件費 and 減価償却費 from the four stores opened in February 2026) is structural and repeats in Q2, while the only H1 series most holders track — the monthly 既存店 line — improved from June's -1.3% to August's +2.2% and reads like a recovery.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-18 (page as fetched; carries 2026/03 through 2026/08 monthly rows)
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's H1 短信 was disclosed 2025-09-26 15:30 JST (https://ccreb-gateway.jp/ir-storage-detail/?id=1135316) and the first full session after it, 2025-09-29, carries the largest negative move in the baseline's twelve-event set at -3.5% — on an H1 that was 増収増益 (revenue +8.0%, OP +1.9%). This shareholder base sold a growing H1. The counterweight is the more recent one: the Q1 print of 2026-06-24 showed OP -10.5% and the stock was ~3,990 that week against 4,020 now, so a same-magnitude profit decline at Q1 was absorbed without lasting damage. Baseline median |move| over twelve estimated events is 2.3%, max 4.59%.

findings.finding: Holding the FY2027/2 guide of ¥12,590m OP requires H2 operating profit of roughly ¥7.34bn, +11% YoY, off an H1 running about -10% — and the entire Oct 1 2026 minimum-wage increase (national weighted average to ¥1,177, +¥56/+5.0%; Okayama ¥1,104 +57, Kagawa ¥1,092 +56) falls inside that H2, so the probability of a 業績予想の修正 being attached to this 短信 is materially higher than the market's default for a company marketing '14期連続最高益'.
findings.source_date: 2026-09 (KSB 瀬戸内海放送 via Yahoo News; the 答申 figures for Okayama ¥1,104 and Kagawa ¥1,092, effective 2026-10-01)
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No downward revision exists in this name's recent record to score directly — the company has revised UP or held. It held the guide at Q1 on 2026-06-24 despite OP -10.5% (https://nikkeiyosoku.com/stock/2742/), which is the single best evidence for the 'they hold again' case and is why this is sized at roughly a third of the move a cut would produce rather than at the cut itself. On the 進捗率 line generally, the baseline's twelve estimated reactions run -3.5% to +4.59% with a 2.3% median, so this name has never travelled far on any single line.

findings.finding: Lopia entered Halows' home market during this half — 広島パセーラ店 2026-04-03 (its first store in Chugoku/Shikoku), 新市店 in Fukuyama 2026-05-15, アルパーク店 in Hiroshima early July — and Halows has responded by cutting prices on selected flyer items across northern Fukuyama, a gross-margin action that appears nowhere in the sales series and is not aggregated anywhere outside the local press.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-09 (Chugoku Shimbun Digital via Yahoo News; the sentence is 「ハローズ（福山市）は、福山市北部エリアでチラシに載せる一部商品の値段を下げた。」)
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print in this name has turned on a competitive-entry line, so there is no reaction history to cite; this is sized as a small qualitative addition to the margin story rather than as its own event. The 2025-09-29 -3.5% after last year's H1 is the only evidence that this holder base will sell a margin narrative at an H1 print.

outside_window.finding: September 2026 月次 (monthly / 既存店) sales, the first month of H2 and the first read on whether Lopia's July Alpark opening bites, publishes in the first days of October — after the exit.
The Oct 1 2026 minimum-wage step (+5.0% national, Okayama ¥1,104, Kagawa ¥1,092) takes effect after the exit and its P&L consequence is only visible from the Q3 print in late December.
Halows' next new store, 川南モール in Fukuyama, opens 2026-12-01 (staff recruitment notice posted 2026-09-16) — the H2 revenue that the +8.8% full-year guide depends on, resolving long after the exit.
Lopia's remaining planned openings in Hiroshima and Yamaguchi (four stores in total by February 2027) land inside H2 and are the real test of the competitive thesis.

lessons_applied: nothing changed — researcher_japan/LESSONS.md is deliberately empty of rules ('Nothing yet. No Japanese run has resolved.') and its three 進捗率 / 月次 / 業績予想の修正 items are written as open questions for the first post-mortems, not as guidance, so there was nothing in it that could legitimately re-size or drop a finding; the pre and post sums are equal honestly.

For the record against open question 2 ('do monthly disclosures pre-empt the print?'): this name is the strong case FOR pre-emption on revenue — the six monthly rows reconstruct H1 営業収益 to within ~0.1% (¥119.0bn against a ¥111,549m base) so there is zero sales surprise — and the case AGAINST it on profit, which the monthlies do not contain. I had already sized finding 1 on that distinction before opening the file, so the file left it standing.

For the record against open question 1 ('does the 進捗率 beat everything else?'): both of my two largest findings are 進捗率 findings, and with no sell-side consensus published for this name there was literally no other bar available.
